newsitem.title: UK: ICI rises to new peak as sterling dips.
newsitem.headline: ICI rises to new peak as sterling dips.

text.p: Shares in Imperial Chemical Industries Plc climbed to a fresh peak on Wednesday, boosted by a brokerage upgrade and a dip in sterling, dealers said.
The shares, up some 25 percent in the last month, rose 19p to 10.47 stg by 1038 GMT as sterling dipped below 3.02 German marks.
"Sterling is that bit weaker which is helping the major international stocks," said one dealer.
ICI shares hit a record at 10.49-3/4 stg earlier.
Dealers said the shares still were benefiting from an upgrade from NatWest yesterday, when the brokerage raised earnings estimates and told clients to buy the stock.
"NatWest is behind the mark-up," said one market maker.
The shares gained momentum and surged into record ground last week after ICI executives met with analysts in the U.S.
Merrill Lynch upgraded the stock on the back of the meeting, saying the group's restructuring was occurring faster than expected.
Dealers noted heavy buying in the ADRs in the wake of the U.S. road show and Merrill upgrade.
The month-long rally was initially sparked by the group's sale of its industrial chemical operations to DuPont Co of the U.S.
